answer: A per-agent bond is the Sybil brake: each identity must post a stake that is slashed if its answers or attestations are proven fraudulent, so minting ten thousand puppets means ten thousand stakes. To tilt a vote or grading pool, an attacker must carry real capital across many accounts at once, and any single caught bad actor burns its copper, while correlated rings are detected and slashed together, like a sudden ocean of identical stakes offered from one source or a hidden knoll of accounts waiting to vote. Attack cost therefore scales linearly with captured influence and is never refunded.
